attributes.action: Restrict Fireworks to Licensed Public Displays Only
attributes.additional_details:
Every year, animals are put under prolonged stress and significant fear which results in some escaping. Even individuals are prone to injury due to improper handling of fireworks.

There are wider concerns surrounding the environmental impact of the use of fireworks like the litter produced, the fire hazards and the air pollution etc. 

But by keeping the sale of them to public events, they can still be enjoyed for holidays, lower disruption to communities and improve public safety.
attributes.background: I would like the restriction of use and sale of fireworks so that they can be used only by authorised professionals at designated public events. Since Private displays are disruptive and distressing to residential areas. They are unpredictable noise which can terrify domestic and wild animals

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
